text: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, the inference framework it uses to serve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The code is on GitHub under Apache 2.0 and runs on Nvidia and Huawei Ascend chips. DeepSeek also released deepseek-recipe, its token encoding component.
